description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeAddress display field for HRM reports, extending a combined display field class and specifying address-related fields and entity alias.

classes.name: EmployeeAddress
classes.description: Represents the address display field for employees in HRM reports, providing specific address-related fields and entity alias information.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of field identifiers representing address components used in the report.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns aliases for entities involved in the display context, in this case ['employee'].
